signals.text: Revenue grew 48% a year over 3 years vs 54% over 5: growth is slowing.
Profit compounded at 56% vs revenue at 48%: operating leverage is showing.
Operating margin expanded 84 bps in 3 years (15.1% → 15.9%).
Working-capital days lengthened by 26 days in 3 years (107 → 133).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was -63% of reported profit: profits are not converting to cash, a red flag.
Free cash flow was negative in 5 of the last 5 years: capex is running ahead of cash generation.

guidance.statement: We are targeting about INR300 crores capex for OSAT, INR300 crores for PCB, and INR250 crores for EMS.
guidance.quote: we said we will be funding for this capex for this year is about INR300 crores for OSAT, INR300 crores for PCB, and about INR250 crores for EMS business.

guidance.statement: Management targets full year revenue of INR450 to INR500 crores combined for OSAT and PCB businesses.
guidance.quote: we have committed a full year revenue of totally INR500 crores between both, INR450 to INR500 crores, which is what we are targeting at this point in time

guidance.statement: Commercial revenue booking and operational startup for OSAT and PCB will happen from Q3 and Q4 FY27.
guidance.quote: going to have a commercial revenue booking from this year, from third quarter and fourth quarter, and we are committed to that.

guidance.statement: Kaynes targets revenue growth at twice the market growth rate for FY27.
guidance.quote: revenue growth, we have committed the 2x of the market growth.

guidance.statement: Management is confident of turning cash positive by the end of the financial year.
guidance.quote: whatever the commitment that we have given to you as a leadership team, that by end of the financial year we'll turn the cash positive, we are pretty confident on that.

delivered.statement: Total revenue for Q1 FY27 reached INR946 crores, reflecting 40% year-on-year growth.
Q1 FY27 EBITDA was INR147.6 crores with a 15.6% margin, representing 31% year-on-year growth.
The company reported a robust order book of around INR9,000 crores.
Standalone EMS business grew 53% year-on-year to INR639 crores.
Smart metering business revenue degrew by 12% year-on-year to INR204 crores.

calls.tone: Cautious on near-term margins and supply chain headwinds, but confident on long-term growth and strategic execution.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the rising working capital days and negative cash flow from operations.
Scepticism regarding sub-optimal returns and high receivables in the smart metering B2C segment.
Repeated concerns raised about cost escalations, component shortages, and gross margin compression.

business.summary: Kaynes Technology is an end-to-end electronics manufacturing services (EMS) player offering conceptual design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing, and life-cycle support across automotive, industrial, aerospace, defense, outer space, and smart metering verticals.

segments.name: EMS Business
segments.note: Core electronic manufacturing services and assemblies

segments.name: Smart Metering (GridCrest)
segments.note: Smart meters manufacturing and installation services

guidance.statement: We will outgrow the market and double the market growth in revenue.
guidance.quote: we chose to say this time that we'll be outgrowing the market and we'll be doubling the market growth, so that our penetration is much more.

guidance.statement: Rail business is expected to grow by around 20% to 25% this year.
guidance.quote: So rail business, I'm expecting this year to grow by around 20%, 25% because of these coming in.

guidance.statement: PCB revenue target is around INR300 crores to INR400 crores for the year.
guidance.quote: I'm sure and certain we will do a good number of PCB of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores

guidance.statement: OSAT revenue target is around INR250 crores to INR300 crores for the year.
guidance.quote: and OSAT of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores.

guidance.statement: OSAT has revenue visibility of over INR25,000 million over the next 5 years.
guidance.quote: In OSAT, the order outlook for both the current year and the medium term remains strong with revenue visibility of over INR25,000 million over the next 5 years.

guidance.statement: Goal is to increase NPD-led and value-added solutions contribution to nearly 30% of total revenue.
guidance.quote: our goal is to steadily increase the contribution of NPD-led and value-added solutions to nearly 30% of the total revenue in the coming years.

delivered.statement: FY26 total revenue stood at INR3,626.4 crores, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 33.2%.
FY26 EBITDA was INR5,741 million with an EBITDA margin of 15.8% and PAT of INR3,639 million.
Q4 FY26 total revenue stood at INR12,426 million, a 26% year-on-year growth.
Core EMS working capital days reduced from 83 days in FY24 to 53 days in FY26.
Metering subsidiary revenue for the full year reached INR971 crores.

calls.tone: Cautious on near-term execution and working capital headwinds, but confident on long-term structural demand and diversification.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the massive variance and credibility between initial guidance of INR4500 crores and actual delivery of INR3600 crores.
Analysts pressed management on the large negative operational cash flow and ballooning receivables against previous neutral guidance.
Scepticism raised regarding surging receivables and installation delays in the metering subsidiary despite previous assurances.
Confusion expressed over management's decision to stop giving exact quantitative revenue guidance.

guidance.statement: Management reiterates the $1 billion revenue guidance for fiscal '28.
guidance.quote: See, on the growth, what we have projected $1 billion, we are still sticking on to that

guidance.statement: Targeting total capex of INR3,200 crores for OSAT and INR1,400 crores for PC Board.
guidance.quote: INR3,200 crores is the total capex for OSAT, INR1,400 crores is the total capex for PC Board.

guidance.statement: Expect minimum INR1,500 crores from the OSAT business and INR1,000 crores from PC Board business.
guidance.quote: you can expect the minimum, you can expect INR1,500 crores from our OSAT business. Similarly, you can expect about INR1,000 crores from PC Board business.

guidance.statement: Expect to spend about another INR400-odd crores of capex in the current year.
guidance.quote: you can take broadly in this year, maybe about another INR400-odd crores of capex will be spent.

delivered.statement: Total revenue for 9 months ended December '25 stood at INR23,837 million, up 37% year-on-year.
Operational EBITDA for the quarter was INR3,778 million with a margin of 15.9%.
Profit after tax for the 9-month period reached INR2,726 million, representing an 11.4% PAT margin.
The pending order book stands at around INR90,000 million.

calls.tone: Confident in long-term demand and strategic roadmaps, while acknowledging near-term execution and delivery delays.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the widening gap between strong order inflows and actual revenue execution.
Repeated concerns raised regarding elevated inventory and receivable days impacting cash flow.
Inquiries made about the sustainability and revenue contribution of the metering segment.

guidance.statement: Balance requirement for OSAT INR10.3 billion will be funded through QIP, spend amount, internal accruals, capex spread over five years and transitory debt.
guidance.quote: First balance requirement for OSAT INR10.3 billion will be funded through QIP and spent amount of about 3.8 billion and balance internal accruals capex spread over five years and some transitory debt.

guidance.statement: Current PCB plan includes capex of 14 billion, balance requirement 3.2 billion and central government subsidy of about 3 billion.
guidance.quote: Second thing is that with regard to PCB, the current plan includes only capex of 14 billion for which the balance requirement is 3.2 billion and up central government subsidy of about 3 billion.

guidance.statement: Second half smart metering revenues are planned to be of the order of about INR300-odd crores.
guidance.quote: And then, of course, in the second half, we also plan some execution, which will be of the nature of about INR300-odd crores.

delivered.statement: Kaynes reported FY25 revenues of 27.2 billion, representing a 51% year-on-year increase.
H2 FY25 net margin for smart metering was 9% with revenues of INR5,327 million and PAT of INR489 million.
Smart metering revenues reached approximately INR500-odd crores in the first half.

calls.tone: Management is defensive on accounting disclosures and governance, yet confident on structural growth and core EMS demand.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned goodwill recognition, reserve adjustments, and discrepancies in consolidation notes.
Pressing questions on rising cash conversion cycles, dense operating cash flows post interest, and elevated capex.
Inconsistencies and omissions found in related party transaction balances between standalone and subsidiary accounts.
Concerns raised over the sharp increase in contingent liabilities and bank guarantees issued to subsidiaries.

credibility.line: Frequent misses on revenue targets, severe working capital inflation, and negative operating cash flows undermine aggressive long-term growth guidance.
